Create `apps/flashcards/app/src/engine/ScoreAudioEngine.test.ts`.

Read the following files for full context before implementing:
- `apps/flashcards/app/src/engine/ScoreAudioEngine.ts` (task A output — the file to test)
- `apps/flashcards/app/src/engine/ScoreEngine.test.ts` — for the VexFlow mock pattern to reuse
- `apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-3-solege-theme/user-stories/us-012-score-audio-engine.md` — acceptance criteria

Write a Vitest test file. Mock both `vexflow` (reuse the same mock pattern from `ScoreEngine.test.ts`) and `tone`.

The Tone.js mock must expose:
- `Tone.start` as a vi.fn()
- `Tone.getTransport()` returning an object with `stop: vi.fn()`, `cancel: vi.fn()`, `start: vi.fn()`
- `Tone.Time` as a function returning `{ toSeconds: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(1) }`
- `Tone.Synth` as a class with `triggerAttackRelease: vi.fn()`, `toDestination: vi.fn().mockReturnThis()`, `dispose: vi.fn()`
- `Tone.Part` as a class with `start: vi.fn().mockReturnThis()`, `dispose: vi.fn()`

Test cases required (all must pass):
1. `ScoreAudioEngine implements RenderEngine` — instantiate and verify `.render` and `.precompute` methods exist
2. `render() injects an SVG element into target` — call render, expect `target.querySelector('svg')` to not be null
3. `render() calls Tone.start()` — verify `Tone.start` was called
4. `render() starts Tone Transport` — verify `Tone.getTransport().start` was called
5. `precompute() stops and cancels Transport` — call precompute, verify `Tone.getTransport().stop` and `Tone.getTransport().cancel` were called
6. `precompute() is idempotent` — call precompute twice with the same data, verify no errors thrown and Transport stop/cancel called each time
7. `render() does NOT call getTransport().start inside precompute` — verify Transport.start is NOT called after precompute alone (only after render)

Use `describe('ScoreAudioEngine', ...)` with `beforeEach` to create a fresh engine and target div. Use `vi.mock('tone', ...)` and `vi.mock('vexflow', ...)` at the top.

Update `apps/flashcards/app/src/main.tsx` to register `ScoreAudioEngine` under the ID `score-audio`.

Read `apps/flashcards/app/src/main.tsx` first — it already imports and registers `ScoreEngine` as `'score'`.

Changes required:
1. Add import at the top (after the existing `ScoreEngine` import):
   ```typescript
   import { ScoreAudioEngine } from '@/engine/ScoreAudioEngine';
   ```
2. Inside the `main()` function, after the existing `engineRegistry.register('score', new ScoreEngine())` line, add:
   ```typescript
   engineRegistry.register('score-audio', new ScoreAudioEngine());
   ```

No other changes to this file. Do not modify the App component, routing, MSW setup, or any other part of main.tsx.

After making the changes, verify the file is valid TypeScript by reviewing the full updated file mentally. The build must pass — run `npm run build` from `apps/flashcards/app` to confirm if possible.
